name: getRoundingInformation
description: Retrieves rounding pattern information including pattern name, type, rounding method, and rounding value. Can retrieve either a specific pattern by code or all available patterns with their full details.

basic.name: getRoundingInformation
basic.description: Retrieves rounding pattern information including pattern name, type, rounding method, and rounding value. Can retrieve either a specific pattern by code or all available patterns with their full details.

args.name: patternCode
args.description: The unique code identifier for the rounding pattern (e.g., "000002"). If not provided, returns all available patterns with their details.

args.name: patternName
args.description: The full or partial name of the rounding pattern to search for (e.g., "test", "Pattern 1")
